title: Micro-dilución en placa para la evaluación de la actividad antimicrobiana
author: Germán Alberto Téllez Ramírez
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8xmhxk6

steps.title: Prepare Bacterial Inoculum
steps.instruction: Recover bacteria from the cell bank and prepare a growth culture.

substeps.instruction: Thaw bacteria according to protocol: streak on selective medium plates and incubate at 37°C for 12-24 hours.
Inoculate one colony into 15ml conical tubes containing 2-5ml of Mueller Hinton broth.
Incubate at 37°C with agitation at 180 rpm for approximately 5-8 hours.

steps.title: Prepare Peptide Dilutions
steps.instruction: Prepare the peptide stock and serial dilutions in a 96-well plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the peptide to a concentration 10 times higher than the maximum concentration to be evaluated (stock solution).
Perform serial dilutions of the stock solution in sterile water or culture medium as required.
Add 5 µL of each peptide dilution to the corresponding wells (columns 1-10).
Add 50 µL of Mueller Hinton medium to column 11 (medium control).
Add 45 µL of medium to rows D and G (compound sterility control).

steps.title: Standardize and Add Bacteria
steps.instruction: Adjust the bacterial concentration and inoculate the microtiter plate.

substeps.instruction: Dilute the grown bacteria to reach a concentration of approximately 3-6 x 10^8 CFU (OD 0.2-0.4 at 600 nm in a 1 cm cell, or OD 0.1 at 570 nm in 100 µL in a 96-well ELISA plate).
Dilute the bacteria 1:1000 in liquid Mueller Hinton medium to reach a working solution concentration of 3-5 x 10^5 CFU.
Add 45 µL of the bacterial working solution to all wells except row D, row H, and column 11.
Incubate for 12-16 hours (critical: not more than 16 hours) at 37°C without agitation.

steps.title: Evaluate Antimicrobial Activity
steps.instruction: Choose one of the following three methods to read the results:

substeps.instruction: Absorbance with Resazurin: Add 5 µL of 440 µM resazurin solution to each well (final concentration 44 µM). Incubate for 2 hours at 37°C. Read absorbance at 570 nm and 603 nm. Calculate Delta (A570nm - A603nm). Subtract the median of blanks (11A:11C) from the Delta. Calculate % Growth = (X / Median of bacterial growth control 12A:12C) * 100, where X is the Delta minus blank.

Fluorescence: Add resazurin to a final concentration of 44 µM. Incubate for 90 minutes. Read excitation/emission at 579/584 (filters ext 565/10; em 600/40). Subtract the median of blanks (11A:11C) from fluorescence values. Calculate % Growth = (X / Median of bacterial growth control 12A:12C) * 100, where X is fluorescence minus blank.

steps.title: Determine Minimum Bactericidal Concentration (MBC)
steps.instruction: Determine the lowest concentration that prevents colony formation.

substeps.instruction: Take 10 µL from up to 3 concentrations (in triplicate) that showed no viable growth.
Streak onto Mueller Hinton agar plates.
Incubate for 18-24 hours at 37°C and count colonies.
Identify the MBC as the lowest concentration that prevents residual colony formation.
